title: IndusInd Club Vistara Explorer credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Club Vistara Explorer card offering CV Points on flight bookings, milestone vouchers, and lounge access for frequent Vistara flyers.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy 2 complimentary movie tickets (up to ₹700 each) monthly with the B1G1 offer, along with an additional ₹100 discount on the Food & Beverage option.|Earn up to a 20% discount on event bookings via BookMyShow.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Concierge
benefitRows.offer: The card provides a concierge service offering pre-trip assistance, hotel reservations, exclusive bookings, flight bookings, and assistance with flowers and gifts.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail any of these services, please call the concierge desk at 1860 267 7777.
